name: Markdown to HTML
tagline: Clean HTML from Markdown, or Markdown from HTML, with a live preview.
seoTitle: Markdown to HTML converter (and HTML to Markdown)
description: Convert Markdown to HTML or HTML to Markdown for free in your browser, with a live preview. Copy or download the result. Nothing is uploaded.

specs.Engines: marked 18 (Markdown to HTML), Turndown 7 (HTML to Markdown), DOMPurify 3 (cleaning)
specs.Markdown flavour: CommonMark plus GitHub tables, strikethrough and task lists
specs.Safety: The preview is always cleaned and never loads images from other sites
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. It's converted inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Is the HTML safe to publish?
faq.a: With the clean option on, scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are removed. Turn it off only when you trust the Markdown and want the HTML exactly as written.
CommonMark, the standard, plus the GitHub extras: tables, strikethrough and task lists.

faq.q: Why does HTML to Markdown change my layout?
faq.a: Markdown has no colours, columns or classes. Headings, lists, links, images, code, quotes and simple tables carry over. Anything else is reduced to its text.

faq.q: Why is an image missing from the preview?
faq.a: The preview never loads images from other websites, so nothing leaves your device. It shows the image's description in brackets. The HTML you copy keeps the image.
